definitions.gloss: a drawn game of go; a tie
definitions.explanation: In the board game go, a result in which the two players' territory is equal, so that neither side wins.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{対局|たいきょく}は{持|じ}{碁|ご}になった。
examples.english: Today's game ended in a draw.

examples.japanese: {持|じ}{碁|ご}は{珍|めずら}しい{結果|けっか}だ。
examples.english: A drawn game is a rare result.

examples.japanese: {両者|りょうしゃ}の{地|じ}が{同|おな}じで、{持|じ}{碁|ご}と{判定|はんてい}された。
examples.english: Both players had the same amount of territory, so it was ruled a draw.

notes:
Compound of {持|じ} + {碁|ご} (go). A drawn result in go, where both players end with equal territory. It has become rare under modern rules, which add {込|こ}み (a points allowance for the second player) to make ties almost impossible.

Mainly a go term. Contrast {勝|か}ち (a win) and {負|ま}け (a loss).
